name: Zain Dana Harper
description: Independent systems engineer, toolmaker, and natural philosopher in Kent, Washington. Five connected open-source platforms spanning deterministic compilers, AI verification, local frontier models, multi-backend rendering, and civic provenance.

author.name: Zain Dana Harper
author.background: Eleven years commercial arboriculture rigging and about thirteen years self-directed software, compiler, graphics, and empirical verification engineering.

flagships.name: BuildLang
flagships.summary: Rust-built compiled systems language (AGPL-3.0-only core buildc; pure OSI MIT universe/ and suite/ via #350, c3b2e5dd) with typed capability effects, 12 targets (C, HLSL, GLSL, WGSL, Metal, SPIR-V, x86-64, RISC-V, WASM), V5 certified e-graph superoptimizer (#344), certified GPU polyhedral tiling + subgroup TV (#346), universe CHECK-FAILS burned down to 150 (126/276 via #349, bddba429), 8 verified 2026 SOTA native .bld kernels (FA4 2.05x, H_64 NVFP4 +19.66 dB rescue, 0.140 ms 1M-token PLATO/NSA, 608 B O(1) Titans/KDA loop), CITATION/codemeta/llms.txt + editors/vscode vsce packaging (#348), 1.18M-record corpus engine, BuildDB (BDB), BuildTeX, and live AGPL-3.0-only funding.json (#345).

flagships.name: The Flywheel
flagships.summary: Pure OSI MIT-licensed (#574, fb877d2e) self-hosted AI workstation and coding harness consolidating 31 packages behind cryptographic offline receipts, Rowan orchestration, Three-Plate Verification Oracle (115/115 recall, 0 false accepts), Data Forge proof-carrying distillation (1,792.8 rows/s, 9/9 planted controls, HIPAA Safe Harbor + Scientific SI + Search-From-The-Start, RFC 6962 Merkle Dataset Cards), unified flywheel super-solver (6/6 fault catch via #565), PUCT oracle tree search + 34.99x RFC 6962 Merkle trace compression (#566), Official MCP Registry manifests (#570), accountable-surface C11/Win32 desktop surface + BuildLang FFI (#571), Win32 DPAPI/CredMan keystore + OAuth 2.0 PKCE/Device Flow + RFC 9421 signer (#572), AgentWorkspace + DelegatedMandate + ApprovalValve (#573), EMET witnessing, and Articulate prose linting.

flagships.name: The Playground
flagships.summary: Pure OSI MIT-licensed (#162, 294f3f3e) unified 11-layer tactile live multimedia studio and rendering engine combining Estuary Perret-lantern metamers, 63 historical creative surfaces & 16 real native repositories, Superframe 9 of 9 bit-exact C++ to BuildLang renderer parity (#161, 9ab3167f), Native RAW DX12/Vulkan/WebGPU (Waves 74-81, 4fd1af1: 96/96 live Skyrim SE moving-camera pass, dark_mo=0.001633 all-time best, 79/79 DXC, 21/21 RTX 4090 GPU bench), Low Water 5-era coastal civilization + bit-exact coastal_kernel.bld (#158), discovery manifests (#157), and Round 3 studio audio (#156: 36/36 Welch pass).

flagships.name: The Commons (CMMNS)
flagships.summary: Local-first, account-free browser extension surfacing account provenance, coordination cues, Content Credentials (C2PA), and fact-checks across 9 social platforms, plus offline Web/AI provenance CLI verifier (#130, 4/4 adversarial catches) and live AGPL-3.0-only funding.json (#131).

flagships.name: Research, Local Frontier Models & Security
flagships.summary: 30 reproducible empirical studies (12 published nulls), 13 DOI-indexed Zenodo preprints, Local Frontier Model Lab (JFC3P-14B-Oracle v5 PASS 66/84 Arm C = 78.57%, +21.43 pp vs Base 14B 48/84, 15/15 long-context zero drift, 21/24 traps, 6/6 A1..A6 PASS; JFC3P-7B-Oracle v4 63/84 Arm C 75.0%, 31 tool calls; caught v2 DRIFT 40/84 kept public; live HF Space zaindanaharper/jfc3p-oracle-demo; JFC3P-Titan-1M v2 10.331 GB RTX 4090 / 5.747 GB Edge at 1M tokens, 291.69x KV compression, 99.85 tok/s; Data Forge 1,792.8 rows/s, 9/9 planted controls, RFC 6962 Merkle Dataset Cards; NOH-4, Plato-Key, AVTR-4R, FRESCO/MoLT), and capability-public security hierarchy.

verificationPolicy: Every empirical claim links to a reproducible local command or SHA-256 receipt. Negative and null results stay published beside positive results.
